old_caption: The video captures a serene sky scene, showcasing the gradual drift of clouds across a vivid blue backdrop. The clouds, appearing as grey and white masses with dark undersides, shift and change shape, creating a sense of slow motion. They drift from left to right across the frame, with no visible characters or animals. The camera remains static, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the tranquil and ever-changing landscape above.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene sky scene, showcasing the dynamic movement of clouds across a vivid blue backdrop. Initially, the sky is filled with fluffy white clouds that gradually shift and change shape, creating a sense of continuous motion. As the video progresses, the clouds begin to thin out, revealing more of the deep blue sky. The clouds transition from dense formations to wispy streaks, adding depth and texture to the scene. The lighting subtly shifts, highlighting the varying densities and colors of the clouds, from bright white to soft gray. Throughout the video, there are no visible characters or animals, focusing solely on the natural beauty of the sky. The camera remains stationary, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the tranquil and ever-changing landscape above.
caption: The video captures a daytime sky with deep blue, a layered gray-and-white cloud bank at lower-left, a faint diagonal wispy band across the right, and scattered top wisps. A small white cumulus puff near upper center drifts slowly downward through open blue as nearby streaks shift. The left bank changes shape, with brighter white cloud mass extending into upper-left and its right edge protrusion moving modestly. The diagonal cirrus band on the right remains largely fixed, and bottom-right horizon clouds stay in place. The differing movements appear as slow drift of separate cloud layers rather than one uniform sweep. A few isolated dark specks appear only briefly and do not form a continuing visible object. The excerpt leaves the sky still changing, with the puff and bank continuing their gradual motion.

infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
